public_body: Cape Cod Commission Committee On Planning And Regulation
overall: The AG found the Cape Cod Commission Committee on Planning and Regulation did not violate the Open Meeting Law. The location was apparent from the notice and the office, and "Other Business" was not discussed.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the May 14 meeting notice did not adequately specify the meeting location, since it gave the office address but no room name or number.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that, even though the meeting notice did not identify a specific room name or number, it was apparent to members of the public where in the Commission offices the meeting was taking place.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the agenda item "Other Business" was not specific enough to inform the public of the topics to be discussed.
allegations.key_passage: Where a public body does not actually engage in discussion of the noticed topic, the Open Meeting Law is not violated with respect to the sufficiency of the meeting notice.
